summary.text: Alexis Rodriguez is the Democratic nominee challenging incumbent Andrew Lanza in New York State Senate District 24. According to BallotReady, she worked at Standard & Poor's and has been a New York City public elementary school educator since 2013. Her listed priorities include fixing roads and dangerous intersections, fighting rising utility and insurance costs, and securing a Staten Island seat on the MTA Board.

paragraphs.text: Alexis Rodriguez graduated from St. John Villa Academy in 2006, earned a bachelor's degree in economics from St. John's University in 2009, and received a master's degree in childhood education (mathematics) from Brooklyn College in 2015, according to BallotReady.
BallotReady lists her work at Standard & Poor's from 2007 to 2012 and as an elementary school educator with the New York City Department of Education since 2013.
Rodriguez is the Democratic candidate on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot; the June 23 Democratic primary was canceled.
